title: DR1's submitted page offers a link that starts a new notification beside the link back to the dashboard; the frontend offers only the dashboard link.

finding.frontend: Under "How to view or amend this notification" the confirmation page offers one link, "Return to your dashboard" (`src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/confirmation/template.njk:25-27`). A user who has just submitted one notification and wants to raise the next one has to go back to the list first and start from the button there.
finding.prototype: DR1 offers both, one under the other: "Return to your dashboard" and "Create a new notification", the second pointing straight at the start of a new one (`app/views/notification-submitted.html:54-57`).
finding.difference: Add a second link below the dashboard link that starts a new notification. It is the same action the dashboard's own start button already performs, so this adds a route to an existing journey rather than a new one, and it needs one new copy string plus its Welsh equivalent.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a link or button that starts a new notification anywhere on the frontend's confirmation page.
